answer: Every alias must buy its own ticket, and the ticket is Registered surveyor benchmark docket sworn before the guild court, priced at 3-year field service, 96 supervised levellings, atlas exam, datum updates. No bulk discount exists: 554 aliases need 554 proofs, and each proof is 101 POA the farm cannot reuse. A farm can print a saffron, it can fake a willow, but it cannot backdate a shale without the archive noticing. Everything above is checkable from public records; nothing here rests on trust.
